description: Read the public profile and match the code. `matched: true` means the account is now verified; otherwise `errorCode` says why (code_not_found, expired, cooldown …). Only call this after the user confirms the code is saved and publicly visible — each check hits the profile and is rate-limited. Requires the write scope + PUBLIC_API_WRITE.
name: vibevo_check_social_account_verification
title: Check the bio-verification code now (creator)
